item.description:
DENVER – August 4, 2026 – Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC) today launched its 2026 GoWild Fall & Winter Pass with immediate access, offering consumers the chance to purchase the pass now for just $199 and begin enjoying unlimited flights right away, rather than waiting for the typical pass period to begin. With the pass valid through Feb. 28, 2027, this means consumers who purchase now will enjoy nearly seven months of limitless travel with Frontier.

Additionally, now through Aug. 17, consumers who purchase the pass will enjoy even more flexibility as they unlock access to dedicated seats for pass holders on every flight, enabling them to plan ahead for travel through Jan. 4, 2027 with early booking fees as low as $29 (and even book on blackout dates for as low as $79*).

“The GoWild Fall & Winter Pass makes it possible to experience fall foliage in New England, hit the slopes in the Rocky Mountains and escape to the beaches of Puerto Rico – and that’s just the beginning of the limitless adventures available to our pass holders for just $199 for a limited time,” said Bobby Schroeter, Chief Commercial Officer, Frontier Airlines. “GoWild continues to get better, combining the freedom of spontaneous, all-you-can-fly travel with more opportunities to plan ahead for the trips and moments that matter.”

 

What you get with the 2026 GoWild Fall & Winter Pass

·        Introductory price of just $199

·        Immediate access to the pass, allowing pass holders to begin flying right away and enjoy unlimited travel with Frontier through Feb. 28, 2027

·        Only $0.01 in airfare per flight segment (plus taxes, fees and charges)

·        Earn miles and Elite Status points on extras like bags and seats

 

Limited time special benefits for all GoWild pass holders:

·        Access to blackout dates when you book by 11:59 pm EDT on Aug. 17 (Early booking fees starting at $29 on most dates and $79 on select peak dates may apply*)

·        Dedicated seats on every Frontier flight for GoWild pass holders to early book by Aug. 17

 

To learn more about the GoWild Fall & Winter pass, and to purchase before the price goes up, click here.

item.title: American Humane Society and Frontier Airlines Launch Sweepstakes Featuring Dream Vacations to Certified Zoos and Aquariums
item.pp:boilerplate: Frontier Airlines, Inc. (Nasdaq: ULCC) is a value-focused airline operating one of the youngest and most fuel-efficient fleets in the United States. With a growing network and continued investment in product upgrades, including the introduction of Starlink, the fastest Wi-Fi in the sky, First Class seating and enhanced loyalty benefits, Frontier is giving customers more comfort, flexibility, and rewards while keeping fares low.
item.description:
American Humane Society is partnering with Frontier Airlines to launch an exciting summer sweepstakes offering unforgettable travel experiences to some of the American Humane Certified™ zoos and aquariums.

Beginning May 27 and running through August 27, participants will have the chance to win a once-in-a-lifetime family vacation to Cancún, Mexico, including a visit to Delphinus to swim with dolphins, and additional “flash prizes” featuring trips to Denver Zoo and Georgia Aquarium.  

The grand prize includes round-trip airfare for four provided by Frontier Airlines, a four-night stay at The Pyramid Cancun all-inclusive resort, and a VIP experience at Delphinus Punta Cancún, where winners will go behind the scenes with marine animal experts and enjoy an unforgettable dolphin experience focused on conservation and animal care.

“American Humane Society is dedicated to inspiring people to celebrate and protect animals everywhere,” said Dr. Robin Ganzert, President and CEO of American Humane Society. “This sweepstakes gives families the opportunity to experience firsthand the incredible work being done by humane-certified zoos and aquariums while creating lifelong memories together and celebrating the human-animal bond.”

Additional flash prizes throughout the summer will include:

  • A trip for four to Denver Zoo, including flights, hotel accommodations and zoo admission.
  • A trip for four to Georgia Aquarium, including flights, hotel accommodations and aquarium admission.

“With a different animal on every one of our plane tails, many of them endangered or threatened species, it is no secret how much we care about wildlife at Frontier,” said Greg Krummenacker, director of brand marketing, Frontier Airlines. “We are proud to partner with the American Humane Society to support their important work, and offer round trip flights to Mexico, Colorado, and Georgia so our lucky sweepstakes winners can visit amazing, humane-certified zoos and aquariums.”  

Participants may enter the sweepstakes by making a donation to support American Humane Society’s lifesaving work to protect animals around the world. A free, no-donation method of entry is also available.

American Humane Society’s Global Humane Certified™ program provides independent, third-party verification of animal welfare practices at zoos and aquariums through rigorous, science-based standards designed to help ensure animals in human care receive exceptional treatment.

The sweepstakes officially launches May 27, 2026, and ends August 27, 2026.

For official rules and to enter, visit: https://www.americanhumane.org/sweepstakes/

###

About American Humane Society: 

American Humane Society is the United States’ first national humane organization and the world’s largest certifier of animal welfare, helping to verify the humane treatment of more than one billion animals across the globe each year. Founded in 1877, American Humane Society has been at the forefront of virtually every major advancement in the humane movement to rescue, care for and protect animals. For more information or to support our life-changing work, please visit www.AmericanHumane.org, follow us on Facebook, X and Instagram and subscribe to our channel on YouTube for the latest breaking news and features about the animals with whom we share our Earth.

item.title: Frontier Launches New Special Offers to Help Former Spirit Customers: “Fly One, Get One” Bonus Miles and Waived Enrollment Fee to Discount Den®

item.description:
DENVER – May 7, 2026 – Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC), America’s largest value airline, is continuing its support for consumers impacted by the shutdown of Spirit Airlines and rewarding its existing loyal customers with the launch of new Frontier Miles and Discount Den offers today.

“Fly One, Get One” This Summer, and Earn an Extra 20,000 Miles Fast*

 Qualifying Frontier MilesTM members can now “Fly One, Get One,” earning 5,000 extra miles for each round trip flown through August 31 (on up to four round trips), enough for up to four one-way domestic award flights (excluding taxes/fees). This is on top of the standard miles they already earn for every dollar spent on Frontier products based on their Elite Status level, allowing them to rebuild miles they lost with Spirit’s operations ending. Members must opt in to the promotion on Frontier’s website before booking (and at least 24 hours prior to departure).

Join Discount Den With Waived Enrollment Fee**

Additionally, for a limited time, Frontier is waiving the enrollment fee to join Discount Den, the airline’s low fare club, providing a $50 savings for consumers as they unlock year-long access to Frontier’s lowest fares and exclusive deals. Now through May 15, consumers can join Discount Den for just the $59.99 annual membership cost, affordably replan their travel, and earn miles and Elite Status Points in the process. Plus, new and current Discount Den members will be rewarded with a $25 voucher for every friend and family member they recruit to join Discount Den along with them, up to ten people, when sharing their Frontier MilesTM membership number, which will serve as their unique referral code. To learn more, click here.

“We recognize the challenges consumers are currently facing as they navigate the cancellation of their planned travel, and we are pleased to offer affordable alternatives and valuable loyalty rewards as they replan with Frontier,” said Bobby Schroeter, Chief Commercial Officer, Frontier Airlines. “With our signature low fares and one of the most rewarding loyalty programs in the sky, we look forward to showing consumers why they should make us their new airline of choice.”

Network-Wide Rescue Fares

These new offers are on top of Frontier’s recently announced systemwide rescue fares, helping customers maintain access to affordable travel with up to 50% off base fares when they book by May 15 using promo code SAVENOW and fly by November 19. Frontier now serves more than 300 routes across the U.S., Caribbean and Mexico, including 100 routes previously flown by Spirit. For more information, and full terms and conditions, click here.

 

*About the Promotional Frontier Miles Offer:

Earn an additional 5,000 Travel Miles for each eligible round-trip flight purchase at Flyfrontier.com. This offer is valid for purchases made directly with Frontier on or after May 6, 2026, for travel completed by August 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM MT. Registration at https://www.flyfrontier.com/earn-up-to-20K-miles must be completed at least 24 hours prior to departure in order to qualify for this promotion. Registration closes on 5/31/2026 at 11:59 PM MT. To qualify, provide your Frontier MilesTM number at the time of booking. Each bonus is specific to the individual passenger/member. Members may earn up to a maximum of 20,000 additional miles under this promotion.  

Each 5,000 mile increment will be posted to the qualifying Frontier Miles account within three business days after completion of each eligible round trip flight during the promotional period. 

GoWild fares, Award Tickets, Group Bookings, Charter flights and free tickets are not eligible for this promotion and will not count toward qualifying round-trip flight totals. All other ticket terms and conditions apply.

 

**About the Promotional Discount Den Offer:

Enrollment fee waiver: 

Standalone purchases of Discount Den will receive a 100% discount on the $50 enrollment fee at Flyfrontier.com from May 6, 2026, to May 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM MT. The discount will be applied at the time of purchase. Limited to one discount per Discount Den member and email. 

$25 Voucher Referral Offer: 

Earn a $25 Frontier voucher every time someone uses your unique referral code (i.e., your Frontier MiIesTM membership number) to purchase Discount Den Membership from May 6, 2026, to May 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM MT, up to a maximum of $250 in vouchers. These vouchers can be redeemed on Frontier purchases including flights, ancillary items, and early booking fees; they do not apply to taxes and fees. The Frontier vouchers will be sent via email within 30 days after the referral code is used. Vouchers will not be awarded for memberships previously purchased or refunded.

DENVER -- May 2, 2026 - Frontier Airlines today announced systemwide rescue fare discounts and is also offering a $199 GoWild All-You-Can-Fly Summer Pass to support travelers affected by Spirit Airlines’ end of operations, helping customers maintain access to low fares.

Frontier currently serves more than 100 routes previously flown by Spirit and will expand further this summer with nine additional routes, plus 15 additional daily flights across 18 former Spirit markets, giving customers more options to rebook their travel plans with confidence while keeping fares low.

“Spirit Airlines played an important role in expanding access to affordable travel and bringing more low fares to more people,” said Bobby Schroeter, Frontier’s Chief Commercial Officer. “We recognize this is a difficult time for their customers and team members. Frontier is making discounted fares available to help people keep their travel plans and maintain access to low fares.”

To support impacted travelers, Frontier is offering up to 50% off base fares* across its network for travel through November 19. Customers can book by May 10 at FlyFrontier.com or on the Frontier mobile app using promo code SAVENOW. Travel on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Saturday qualifies for a 50% base fare discount with a 21-day advance purchase, while other days of week are eligible for a 10% discount with no advance purchase required. item.description:
DENVER – October 1, 2025 – Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC), America’s Low Fare Airline, today announced the launch of its new Platinum Status Challenge, giving travelers the chance to enjoy Elite Platinum Status through the end of next year. By enrolling in the challenge for just $99 and earning 12,500 Elite Status Points within 90 days, participants will unlock Platinum benefits through December 31, 2026, making every trip more rewarding.

 

Elite Platinum Status Benefits Include:

·       Unlimited companion travel (choose a different companion for every flight)

·       Free checked bag, plus free carry-on for everyone on the booking

·       Complimentary premium seat selection at booking, upgrades to UpFront Plus seating 12 hours before departure, and eligibility for First Class upgrades beginning in early 2026 (all based on availability)

·       Boarding Group 1 priority access

·       No change or cancel fees

·       Priority customer care

 

Normally, 50,000 Elite Status Points are required to achieve Platinum, but the Platinum Challenge makes it possible with just 12,500. Enrollment is open through December 31, 2025.

 

How to Earn Points Quickly

Elite Status Points accrue on purchases made through FlyFrontier.com or the Frontier mobile app, including flights, bags, seats, and bundles. Members earn 10x points per $1 spent, with higher multipliers for existing elite tiers. The Frontier Airlines World Mastercard®, issued by Barclays, earns 1x point per $1 spent on everyday purchases and can be used to accelerate progress toward Platinum when combined with travel spend. 

“Platinum Status delivers incredible value, flexibility, and comfort for our most loyal travelers,” said Bobby Schroeter, Frontier’s Chief Commercial Officer. “From unlimited companion travel to free bags, upgrades to premium seating, and now upcoming eligibility for First Class upgrades in 2026, the Platinum Challenge is an extraordinary opportunity at a fraction of the normal requirement.”

To learn more about the Platinum Status Challenge and to register, visit https://www.flyfrontier.com/PlatinumChallenge

 

The New Frontier

The Platinum Challenge is part of a larger transformation at Frontier Airlines, known as The New Frontier. This evolution is about more than low fares – it’s about pairing affordability with a better overall travel experience. Customers are already seeing meaningful changes: clearer and more flexible fare options, enhanced support, and new seating choices designed to add comfort without losing value.

In 2026, Frontier will introduce First Class seating, offering unmatched comfort at Frontier’s trademark affordable prices, with Platinum members eligible for complimentary upgrades. Combined with upgrades into Premium and UpFront Plus seating, along with unlimited companion travel, these enhancements reflect Frontier’s commitment to making every journey simpler, more comfortable, and more rewarding.

item.description:
DENVER – September 2, 2025 – Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC), America’s Low Fare Airline, announced its biggest GoWild! All-You-Can-Fly Annual Pass deal ever, providing even more value to new passholders who want to enjoy nearly two years of limitless adventures. Now through September 5, consumers can purchase Frontier Airlines’ 2026-2027 GoWild! All-You-Can-Fly Annual Pass for just $299* (regularly $599) - less than what a customer pays for a domestic ticket on other U.S. airlines** - and begin using it right away, rather than waiting for the standard travel period to begin in May 2026, providing an extra eight months of unlimited flights with Frontier. 

“This is our most exciting GoWild! offer yet,” said Bobby Schroeter, Chief Commercial Officer, Frontier Airlines. “We’ve never offered a GoWild! All-You-Can-Fly Annual Pass with so much travel time built in.  For just $299* - half off the regular $599 price - our customers can now get nearly two years of unlimited GoWild! flights on Frontier Airlines.  This early access price won’t last, so now is the time to lock in the best value we’ve ever offered from America’s Low Fare Airline.” 

To learn more and purchase the 2026-2027 GoWild! All-You-Can-Fly Annual Pass, click here.  

 

Included With Your GoWild! All-You-Can-Fly Annual Pass: 

  • Special early access price: $299* (normally $599) 
  • Unlimited flights to 100+ destinations across the U.S., Latin America, and the Caribbean, including Puerto Rico. 
  • Flexibility built in: confirm domestic flights the day before travel, international up to 10 days in advance, or lock in select flights early for a small fee. 
  • Incredible value: pay only $0.01 in airfare per flight (plus taxes, fees, and charges). 
  • Keep your rewards growing: earn FRONTIER Miles on extras like bags and seats, and extend mileage expiration with pass use. 

 

* Important things to know about the GoWild! Pass: 

  • Flights can be booked and confirmed the day before flight departure for domestic travel and 10 days before flight departure for international travel 
  • Plan ahead and book select flights early. Simply search and choose GoWild! when available. A GoWild! Early Booking charge may apply 
  • Flights must be booked at FlyFrontier.com and the Frontier mobile app 
  • Flights are subject to blackout periods 
  • Flights do not include any add-on products like bags or seat assignments 
  • Access to all domestic and international destinations Frontier serves 
  • For each flight, passholders pay $0.01 in airfare plus applicable taxes, fees and charges at the time of booking. 
  • Flights and seats are subject to availability; last seat availability is not guaranteed 
  • The GoWild! Pass is non-transferable. The passholder is the only passenger allowed to travel with GoWild! Pass privileges 
  • Your pass will automatically renew unless you cancel. Customers may opt out of auto renewal on their Frontier Airlines profile page 
  • You must be 18 years or older and a resident of the United States to purchase the GoWild! Pass. The passholder may be under the age of 18 and must be a resident of the United States. Passholders under the age of 13 must be enrolled by their parent or legal guardian. Children under the age of 10 must travel accompanied by a passenger who is at least 15 years old 
  • Seats available to passholders are capacity controlled, limited in quantity and are offered on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last 

 

Frontier Airlines has introduced sweeping changes to its product and customer service offerings, ushering in ‘The New Frontier.’ Among the enhancements is UpFront Plus seating, an upgraded seating option with extra leg and elbow room in the first two rows of the aircraft. Customers in UpFront Plus enjoy a window or aisle seat with extra legroom and a guaranteed empty middle seat. The airline also now offers unlimited companion travel for its most loyal customers, with the flexibility to choose a different companion on every Frontier flight. Debuting in late 2025, Frontier will begin offering First Class seating, combining unmatched comfort and space at Frontier’s trademark affordable prices. 

Frontier continues to innovate with its industry-leading frequent flyer program, FRONTIER Miles, which allows customers to ‘Get It All For Less.’ Members earn miles quickly and get rewarded for each dollar spent on Frontier products. Miles accrue based on dollars spent with a standard 10X multiplier: $1 = 10 miles, with multipliers increasing at every elite level up to 20X. Elite status is attainable at only 10,000 miles and offers perks such as priority boarding, seat selection and free bag(s) depending on status level. Like the airline, FRONTIER Miles is also family friendly, offering easy family pooling of miles making it simple for families to enjoy rewards together. Joining is free. 

 

** Based on the weighted average of 2024 U.S. Department of Transportation, Origin and Destination Survey data (DB1A/DB1B) for roundtrip itineraries flown during fiscal year 2024 within the United States by American Airlines, Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, Southwest Airlines, JetBlue Airways, Alaska Airlines, Allegiant Air, Avelo Airlines, Breeze Airways, Spirit Airlines, and Sun Country Airlines.

item.description:
DENVER – August 25, 2025 – Frontier Airlines (Nasdaq: ULCC), America’s Low Fare Airline, today announced an unprecedented lineup of loyalty offers.

For a limited time, FRONTIER Airlines World Mastercard® cardmembers can earn companion certificates starting at just $3,000 in everyday spend. New FRONTIER Miles members can take advantage of Miles Match from other airlines, allowing them to match up to their combined mileage balances across multiple qualifying airlines, and travelers with frequent flier memberships at select carriers can unlock instant Elite Gold status at Frontier.  

“We’re proving that low-fare travel can also be the most rewarding,” said Bobby Schroeter, Chief Commercial Officer, Frontier Airlines. “With companion certificates, Miles Match from multiple airlines, and the opportunity to receive instant Elite Gold Status with Frontier, no other U.S. airline is giving travelers this much value.” 

 

EARN COMPANION CERTIFICATES WITH THE FRONTIER AIRLINES WORLD MASTERCARD  

Frontier, in partnership with Barclays US Consumer Bank, is adding a powerful new benefit for FRONTIER Airlines World Mastercard cardmembers: the ability to earn companion certificates on top of the card’s existing rewards.

For purchases made between now and January 31, 2026, cardmembers will earn companion certificates at the following amounts:  

  • First certificate at $3,000 in purchases  
  • Second certificate at $10,000 in purchases  
  • Third certificate at $20,000 in purchases  

Each certificate will cover the fare for a companion of the cardmember’s choice on future travel with Frontier, with the cardmember simply paying government taxes and fees starting at $15.30*. Certificates can be redeemed for roundtrip travel within one year of issuance.  

 
 To learn more and apply for the FRONTIER Airlines World Mastercard, visit flyfrontier.com/companion.

 

MILES MATCH FROM OTHER AIRLINES 
For the first time, new FRONTIER Miles members can match up to 1 million miles of their combined mileage balance from multiple qualifying airlines**. When you join, Frontier will match the miles you’ve earned with other airlines - you just need to earn that same number of miles with Frontier in the next 12 months to unlock them.  

Examples: 

A traveler with 10,000 miles across other airlines who earns 10,000 miles with Frontier within 12 months will receive 20,000 FRONTIER Miles for future trips. 

If you have 200,000 miles with other airlines, but only want to input 50,000 to match with Frontier over the next 12 months, you can just use that portion of your other airline balance; you do not need to utilize the entire total.  

 To learn more and apply, visit flyfrontier.com/milesmatch.

 

UPGRADE FROM OTHER AIRLINES TO FRONTIER ELITE GOLD STATUS 
 Frontier is also extending its popular program that enables consumers to upgrade from other airline loyalty programs to Frontier Elite Gold Status: consumers with a Southwest Rapid Rewards®, JetBlue TrueBlue®, Spirit Free Spirit®, or Alaska Mileage Plan™ can unlock instant Elite Gold status at Frontier through December 2026 for just $69. 

Elite Gold perks include a free carry-on bag, priority boarding, free preferred seat selection, and complimentary upgrades to premium and UpFront PlusSM seating. 
 
 To learn more apply, visit flyfrontier.com/goldstatus.

 

 

*COMPANION CERTICATE TERMS AND CONDITIONS 

This offer is exclusive to FRONTIER Airlines World Mastercard® cardmembers and is not transferable. If your account is closed or you switch to another product during the promotional period, you may no longer be eligible for this promotion. 

If you spend $3,000 in purchases, less credits, returns and adjustments (“Net Purchases”) with transaction dates from 8/25/2025 through 1/31/2026 (“Promotion Period”), you will earn one (1) companion certificate. If you spend $10,000 in Net Purchases during the Promotion Period, you will earn a second companion certificate, for a total of two (2) companion certificates. If you spend $20,000 in Net Purchases during the Promotion Period, you will earn a third companion certificate, for a total of three (3) companion certificates. The maximum number of companion certificates you can earn during the Promotion Period is three. Each companion certificate is valid for one round-trip flight and will expire one year from the date of issuance. You can bring any companion on select bookings for the cost of government taxes and fees (starting at $5.60), provided the companion has a FRONTIER Miles account number and is added at the time of initial booking within the same ticket. In order to use the companion certificate, members must be logged into their FRONTIER Miles account at the time of booking to ensure the companion benefit applies. Blackout dates apply. The companion certificate has no cash value and may not be applied to past bookings or subscriptions, refunded, sold, bartered, or traded. 

This offer may not be achievable based on the assigned credit line and ability to maintain that credit line. Failure to maintain your creditworthiness during the offer period may result in actions on your account, such as a credit line decrease, that would reduce your ability to take advantage of this offer. If earned, the companion certificate(s) will be awarded by Frontier to your FRONTIER Miles frequent flyer account within 4 weeks from the end of this promotion.  

 

**TERMS FOR MILES MATCH 

Miles Match Terms & Conditions: 

For the first time, new FRONTIER MilesSM members can match their combined mileage balance from multiple qualifying airlines, up to 1 Million miles. When you join, Frontier will match the miles you’ve earned with other airlines - you just need to earn that same number of miles with Frontier in the next 12 months to unlock them.  

The following terms and conditions govern the FRONTIER Miles Balance Earn Match Offer (the "Offer"). By participating in this Offer, you agree to these terms and conditions in their entirety.  

Definitions  

  • FRONTIER Miles: The loyalty program offered by Frontier Airlines, where members earn miles through eligible activities.  
  • Miles Match: A program where Frontier Airlines matches and doubles the miles earned by participants, based on the number of loyalty miles submitted from other airline loyalty programs, up to 1 Million miles for each individual.  
  • Mileage Match: The portion of loyalty miles submitted by the participant from other airline loyalty programs that they commit to earning with FRONTIER Miles.  
  • Earned Miles: Miles earned through eligible activities with FRONTIER Miles, such as flying with Frontier Airlines or spending with the Frontier Airlines co-branded credit card.  

Eligibility  

This Offer is available only to new FRONTIER Miles members. Existing FRONTIER Miles members are not eligible to participate. To qualify, participants must create a FRONTIER Miles account and submit the required application form during the specified promotional period.  

Promotional Period  

The Offer is valid only for applications submitted between August 25 and September 26, 2025. Applications submitted outside of this window will not be considered. 

How to Participate  

  1. Participants must complete the official Offer form, providing:   
  • Their FRONTIER Miles account number.  
  • Documentation showing mileage balances from other airline loyalty programs.  
  • The portion of their loyalty miles they wish to submit as their "Mileage Match."  
  1. A subsequent email will be sent following form submission to collect documentation. Documentation must include an official statement from the respective airline loyalty program(s), clearly displaying the participant's name, account number, and mileage balance.  
  1. Participants may submit a portion of their loyalty miles from one or more airline loyalty programs as their Mileage Match. However, they must have enough miles in their accounts to support the Mileage Match submission.  
  1. The total mileage balances submitted will constitute the Mileage Match. Participants are not required to bet all of their miles from other airline loyalty programs.  
  1. Incomplete or inaccurate forms will render the application void and disqualify the participant.  

Earning Requirement  

Participants are required to earn an equivalent number of FRONTIER Miles to their submitted Mileage Match ("Earned Miles") through eligible activities within 12 months from the date of enrollment in the Offer. Eligible activities include, but are not limited to:  

  • Flying with Frontier Airlines.  
  • Spending with the Frontier Airlines co-branded credit card.  

Matching and Crediting of Miles  

Upon verification that the Earned Miles requirement has been met:   

  • Frontier Airlines will match and double the Earned Miles, up to 1 Million miles for each individual.  
  • Matched miles will be credited to the participant's FRONTIER Miles account within 4-5 weeks.  
  • Miles earned through flights will only be credited after the flights have been completed. 
  • If the participant fails to meet the Earned Miles requirement within the 12-month period, no matched or additional miles will be credited.  

Restrictions  

  • This Offer does not include loyalty miles purchased through Points.com or other third-party platforms. Only miles earned directly through eligible Frontier activities qualify for the Earned Miles requirement.  
  • Submissions containing falsified or fraudulent documentation will result in immediate disqualification.  
  • Participants are encouraged to submit a realistic Mileage Match, as failure to meet the Earned Miles requirement will result in forfeiture of the match.  

Important Information  

This Offer involves matching and doubling earned FRONTIER Miles; no miles from other airline loyalty programs will be transferred to the participant's FRONTIER Miles account. Participants' miles with other airlines will remain with those respective programs. Participants must ensure that their Mileage Match does not exceed the total number of miles available in their other airline loyalty programs. Frontier Airlines reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate this Offer at any time without prior notice.  

Consent and Privacy  

By participating in this Offer, participants consent to the use of their personal information for the purposes of administering the Offer. Personal information will be processed in accordance with Frontier Airlines' Privacy Policy.
